role: Declares the entity tracker: the packet kinds it can emit, the flat tracker_packet record, one tracker_entry per tracked entity with its last scaled position, angles and motion, and a fixed 512-entry tracker.

structs.name: tracker_packet
structs.java: the S04/S0D/S0E/S0F/S11/S12/S13/S15-S19/S1B/S1C/S20/S21/S22/S23/S26/S28 server packets, flattened into one record

structs.name: tracker_entry
structs.java: EntityTrackerEntry plus the tracked entity's position, motion and angles

gpu: line 77: struct tracker holds a fixed 512 entries inline (flat, GPU-friendly, but a hard cap)
lines 40, 46-47, 50: fixed-size arrays inside every tracker_packet (64 ids, 512 chunk coordinates, 64 records), about 6 KB per packet
notes: Most packet kinds in the enum (S0D, S0E, S0F, S11, S13, S1B, S1C, S04, S20-S28) are parsed by test_clientworld.c from recordings; tracker.c itself emits only S12, S15, S16, S17, S18 and S19. lane/coldaudit: an entry's class is enum tracker_class (tracker_class_name its Java name, tracker_class_of the reverse), not a 32-byte string; the id index is one array of (id, entry) slots over a power-of-two prefix (index_mask) grown with the entries.
